admission.workflow: Register and execute statically packaged Proctor intents with service access, metadata argument validation, override stacking, deterministic disposal, execution events, and immediate missing-command failure.

items.rationale: The canonical Microsoft MIT text is preserved as the local notice for this cluster.
The complete original shared contract is now owned by settings-editor-presentation; existing callers use the same canonical path.

Only the localized-string pair is required by command metadata; the admitted localization compatibility seam already owns the exact value/original shape, while the complete action model belongs to slice 8.

Preserve the complete service contract, event, registry stacking, aliases, metadata, argument validation, disposal, and lookup behavior while satisfying the localized-string type through the admitted packaged seam.
Run the complete command-registry owner suite through Node's built-in runner and admitted Proctor paths.
The null helper is not owner behavior; Proctor service tests exercise the real command service and registry interface.

Preserve synchronous handler invocation, service access, ordered before/after events, promise normalization, failure propagation, and delayed service registration while removing extension-host activation and telemetry logging that do not exist in Proctor's closed composition.
Its synchronous execution, ordering, missing-command, event, and result/error cases are retained in focused Proctor service tests; extension activation cases are excluded by the closed product model.
Proctor has no extension host or public extension interface; all executable contributions and commands are packaged and statically selected.
The broad VS Code logging service is not admitted as a hidden dependency of command execution; later Proctor diagnostics must be bounded and redacted by their own interface.

dependencies.rationale: The admitted base runtime supplies events, iteration, linked lists, lifecycle, and constraint validation.
The admitted platform foundation supplies service access and delayed service registration.
The private compatibility seam supplies the exact localized/original metadata pair until action presentation owns localized product labels.

divergences.summary: Product commands must use the prctr namespace, arrive through literal packaged manifests, and fail immediately when absent; no extension activation, remote module, visibility state, or context key may register or authorize them.

Verify namespace enforcement, synchronous invocation ordering, service execution events, promise results, missing-command failure, and override restoration.
Verify layer direction, cycles, static imports, and literal Proctor composition ownership.
Verify schema, local digest, marker, license reference, unique ownership, divergence, and evidence parity without a VS Code checkout.
